record.title: It Takes Two
record.description: It Takes Two is a co-op-only action-adventure platformer by Hazelight Studios. Two players control Cody and May, a couple transformed into dolls, and must cooperate through highly varied levels where new mechanics appear constantly. On Nintendo Switch it supports same-system co-op, local wireless, and online play, with Friend's Pass allowing a friend to join without owning the full game.

record.titleEn: Layers of Fear: The Final Masterpiece Edition
record.titleKu: Layers of Fear: The Final Masterpiece Edition
record.description:
The definitive Unreal Engine 5 edition of the psychological-horror series, combining Layers of Fear, Layers of Fear 2, released DLC, and connective chapters into one narrative.

The anthology follows multiple artists and storytellers spiraling into obsession, guilt and fractured memory. Each chapter explores a different perspective, haunted setting and emotional collapse. Additional chapters connect the entries together and reframe the broader narrative. The Final Masterpiece Edition positions the entire package as the definitive way to experience the saga.
